name: manual_2ae843
claim: Check a new validation against the frozen contract grammar, not a nearby stricter helper: an ASCII-identifier check on a field the contract defines as non-blank UTF-8 breaks valid keys.

decisions.notes: issuer_key_id was validated with the ASCII identifier grammar although the contract allows non-blank UTF-8 up to 1,024 bytes; a dedicated validate_key_id restored the contract.

rationale: issuer_key_id was validated with the ASCII identifier grammar although the contract allows non-blank UTF-8 up to 1,024 bytes; a dedicated validate_key_id restored the contract.
